SnowReport.Report:
October 29, 2026
 Well folks, as we grow closer and closer to the season we've got a few items for you to remember. Until we reach opening day, please note: Ski Patrol is not currently on duty, and avalanche mitigation is not taking place. Avalanches can occur at any time, especially during and after periods of heavy snowfall. Unmitigated terrain presents serious risks, and conditions can change rapidly.

Our mountain crews are actively preparing for the season, with employees and heavy machinery operating across the mountain. Please respect all closures, avoid active work areas, and give our teams plenty of space.

Snowfall totals will start to be reported as we get closer to the season.

Resorts.ParkingAreasDescription:
The Reservation System Opens at Midnight on November 22

Parking Reservation Information for the 2025/26 Season
For the 2025–2026 winter season, Crystal Mountain will continue to require parking reservations on Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays. Parking is included with lift access if reserved within seven days of your visit. Guests may also reserve earlier for a $10 daily fee.

Reservation Requirement
Guests arriving before noon on Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays must make a parking reservation. Exceptions include Anytime A Lot and Gold Hills pass holders.
Holiday dates: December 26–January 1, Martin Luther King Day (January 19), and Presidents' Day (February 16).

Reservation Details
• The system opens at 12:00 a.m. on November 22.
• Reserve for the season for $10 per day or within seven days (starting at midnight) for free with lift access.
• Reservations can be canceled but are non-refundable.
• New: Guests can join a waitlist when reservations are full. Your waitlist status appears in your profile, and you’ll be notified if a spot opens. Cancel by 6:00 a.m. the day of if no longer needed.
• No reservations are required Monday through Friday (excluding holidays) or after 12:00 p.m. on weekends and holidays.
• Reservations are guaranteed until noon; after that, parking is first come, first served.

Lift Access
Guests with an Ikon Pass, Crystal Mountain Pass, 3-Day Frequency Pass, day tickets, or other lift access products can use their pass or itinerary number to reserve free parking within seven days of their visit.
Guests without lift access will be charged $10 per reservation. If lift access is purchased on-site, that $10 will be credited toward the ticket purchase.

Carpool Information
• Carpools must have four or more occupants.
• All carpools must make a reservation. Attendants will verify status on arrival.
• Carpool parking is in the south end of C Lot (uphill). Overflow vehicles will be redirected as needed.
• New: 100 additional carpool spots added for the 25/26 season.
• Guests can meet at Enumclaw Expo Center to form carpools.
• New: Try the SP+ Carpool App (available for Apple and Android).

EV Charging
First 4 hours: $6/hour. Over 4 hours: $15/hour.
Parking reservations still apply. Charging is first come, first served.
Guests can set up a FLO account before arrival at flo.com.

ADA Parking
Guests with ADA permits must make a reservation on weekends and holidays. Attendants will direct ADA guests to designated spots upon arrival.

No Reservation, No-Show, and Cancellation Policies
• Vehicles without reservations will be stopped at F Lot. On-site reservations are $20 if space is available.
• If reservations are full, no on-site parking is allowed.
• Be prepared to show your receipt at F Lot.
• Vehicles parked without reservations may be ticketed.

You may cancel reservations up to 6:00 a.m. on the day of. Cancellations after that are considered no-shows. Two no-shows will result in suspension from future reservations. Paid parking reservations are non-refundable.

Crystal Express Shuttle Service
The free Crystal Express Shuttle runs from the Enumclaw Expo Center December through mid-March (weekends and holidays).
New: Two shuttle no-shows will also result in suspension from future reservations.

Reservations open December 6, with the first shuttle running December 14.
Holiday shuttle dates: December 26–January 2, January 19, and February 16.

Shuttle Schedule
Depart Enumclaw: 6:30 a.m., 7:30 a.m., 8:00 a.m., 9:00 a.m.
Depart Crystal: 2:30 p.m., 3:30 p.m., 4:30 p.m., 5:00 p.m.

Contacts
SP+ Parking: 360.820.3102
Crystal Mountain: 833.279.7895 or gservice@skicrystal.com

Parking and related policies are subject to change throughout the season.
